# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Sends Seth for the Oil of Mercy

---

**1** Adam called Seth and said: 'Seth, my son, hurry to paradise — you and your mother Eve. Bring me a little of the oil of mercy from the tree of mercy, so I can be anointed and find relief from this pain.'

**2** 'Father,' Seth said, 'I don't know the way to paradise. I have not seen it since we were expelled.'

**3** 'Go east of paradise,' Adam said. 'You will find the footprints your mother and I left — we walked there together. Follow them and you will find the gate.'

**4** Seth got up, took his mother Eve by the hand, and headed toward paradise.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
